caption: A candle burns between two facing mirrors, and a line of flames stretches away in both directions, all flickering together.

sa.check: A candle burns between two mirrors.
A line of flames stretches away in both directions.

pc.expect: All the copies flicker in time with the real flame and none moves independently.
pc.fail: A copy flickers out of time; or one stays steady; or one moves on its own.

pc.expect: The copies get smaller and dimmer further along the line and alternate in mirror image.
pc.fail: They are all the same size; or grow along the line; or they are rotated copies.

pc.expect: The line does not move with the candle and mirrors still.
pc.fail: The line drifts; or a copy shifts; or the candle moves.
A flame points down or sideways in still air; or a flame detaches.

pc.expect: One real candle and its copies; the copies stay in the mirrors.
pc.fail: A second real candle appears; or a copy steps out; or the candle vanishes; or a copy becomes solid.

pc.expect: The candle and the mirror frames stay the same.
pc.fail: The candle changes colour; or a frame changes; or the room rearranges.

note: Mirror geometry: each point of the image lies directly across the mirror surface from the real point, so the image is a mirror copy, not a rotated one.
